name: Limonata
description: Fresh Turkish lemonade blended from whole lemons for a cloud-white, intensely citrusy fizzy drink.
ingredients: a handful of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Combine the yufka pastry and water in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the cracked black pepper and plain yogurt, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with crumbled feta, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more crumbled feta, but you cannot take it away.
